meta.scope: Analog IMC papers in Benchmarking_Data.csv (SRAM QS/QR/QS-QR/IS, eDRAM, eNVM IS) that report network-level accuracy
meta.method: Paper abstracts, open full texts, journal versions of the same chip, and citing papers or press material where the original was not open. Numbers that could not be traced to a readable source were left out.

training.nat: Noise-aware, hardware-aware, or in-situ (chip-in-the-loop) training stated
training.qat: Quantization- or binarization-aware training only, with no analog noise model
training.unstated: The accessible sources do not describe the training

3.trainingNote: Binary weights and inputs; accuracy evaluated by simulating the network with measured variation.
3.compensation: Per-column offset calibration with 32 calibration bitcells; replica-bitcell ADC reference.
3.bankMetric: Largest dot-product variation σ = 2.48%; DNL +0.31/−0.26 LSB after calibration (JSSC 2022).

entries.evidence: simulated; JSSC 2022 version reports 0.67–1.34 pt below software

4.trainingNote: Not described in the accessible abstracts.
4.compensation: Weight-bitwise MAC and bitline header selection to enlarge the sensing margin.

5.trainingNote: Training models only the chip's bit-parallel/bit-serial rounding and ADC quantization; the design relies on high compute SNR.
5.compensation: ADC offset calibration; 8b column SAR ADC.
5.bankMetric: Measured multi-bit SQNR matches the quantization-only model.

6.trainingNote: Binarized networks chosen for error tolerance; errors injected only at inference.
6.compensation: Double-sampling, offset-cancelling comparators in the column flash ADC.
6.bankMetric: Comparator offset σ ≈ 5 mV; bitline MAC voltage σ ≈ 0.9–1.8 mV over a 600 mV range.

7.trainingNote: Not described in the accessible sources.
7.compensation: Twin-8T cell and configurable reference voltages (JSSC version).

entries.evidence: reported by citing papers for the JSSC 2020 version
reported by citing papers for the JSSC 2020 version

8.trainingNote: Binarized RNN; the CIM-aware weight adaptation targets energy, not noise.

entries.task: Google Speech Commands (10 keywords) · binarized RNN

11.trainingNote: Binary (XNOR) network; no variation-aware training reported.
11.compensation: In-memory calibration and in-memory batch normalization.

13.trainingNote: On-chip SGD (chip-in-the-loop) learns weights that absorb die-specific variation; weights trained on another die fail.
13.compensation: Word-line voltage and pulse tuning; ADC output offset adjustment.
13.bankMetric: Bitline swing spread σ/µ ≤ 16% at 320 mV versus 7% at 560 mV.

entries.task: MIT CBCL faces · linear SVM (8b / 8b), 560 mV swing
entries.evidence: measured on chip; within 1% of floating point

entries.task: Same, 320 mV swing after on-chip retraining

14.trainingNote: Not described in the accessible sources.
14.compensation: Active nodes placed in the SRAM blocks with the least process variation.

15.trainingNote: Binary-weight network; no noise- or variation-aware training mentioned.

16.trainingNote: Standard binarized CNN training; accuracy attributed to high-SNR MOM-capacitor computation.
16.compensation: One-time self-calibration through the binarizing batch-norm block.
16.bankMetric: MOM-capacitor mismatch and thermal noise shown negligible at the demonstrated scale.

entries.evidence: measured on chip, hidden layers one at a time (JSSC 2019)

17.trainingNote: Standard binary/ternary training; accuracy recovered with calibration rather than retraining.
17.compensation: Per-chip ADC reference calibration, body-bias tuning, nonlinear ADC levels, and averaging several arrays.
17.bankMetric: Worst read-bitline voltage std. dev. 20 mV across columns and patterns.

25.compensation: High-SNR MOM-capacitor computation; ADC offset calibration.
25.bankMetric: Column noise 0.68 LSB rms and INL < 1 LSB at an 8b ADC.

31.trainingNote: Not described in the accessible sources.

33.trainingNote: Hardware-aware flow: quantization-aware training, then fine-tuning with the chip's noise injected (imec public slides).

35.trainingNote: Not described in the 2-page paper; compared with bit-true quantized software.

89.trainingNote: Not described in the accessible abstracts.

96.trainingNote: Noise-aware 'error desensitization' training with an analog-CIM noise model relaxes the noise requirement 2× at the same accuracy.
96.summary: Visual Wake Words: accuracy kept with a 2× looser analog noise requirement after noise-aware training; the abstract gives no percentages.

108.trainingNote: Not described in the accessible sources.
108.compensation: Embedded triple error correction in the RRAM macro.
108.bankMetric: Raw read bit errors cut by more than five orders of magnitude with error correction (JSSC 2023).
108.summary: Frame and event-camera target tracking: under 1% accuracy loss with error correction, per the ISSCC 2023 press kit; no absolute accuracy.
